title.narrative: Strengthening household capacity for climate adaptive and resilient livelihoods to tackle food insecurity and under-nutrition in southern Bangladesh (BDH4L)

description.narrative: The project aims to promote a climate smart and adaptive livelihood for the targeted households to achieve food and nutrition security. The project will introduce new model and production techniques for CCA and enhance homestead food production. Asset building and diversification of livelihoods with market linkage will be another aspect of the intervention to ensure sustainable income to address chronic food and nutrition insecurity.
